dossier.scp_unleashed.017.title: Shadow Person
dossier.scp_unleashed.017.caption: SCP-017 at rest in a lit corner of its chamber, under full lighting.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-017 is to be held in a sealed chamber that is brightly lit at every hour.
All lighting must be permanent and built into the structure, on two separate systems.
While the chamber is lit, SCP-017 is inert. It will find a corner and stay there. Personnel are not to approach it.
**The chamber is never to be allowed to go dark.**
Do not rely on lights that must be carried, lit or refuelled. Lights of that kind have failed near SCP-017 before.
Any loss of light is a breach. If SCP-017 is loose, stay in bright light until day and do not strike at it.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-017 is a humanoid figure about two metres tall, made of a shadow-like substance. Its limbs are long and thin. It has no face.
In bright light it is inert. It walks slowly to the nearest corner and sits there, facing the walls, while the light holds.
In darkness it wakes, and its body all but vanishes. Only two points of white light where its eyes should be, and a trail of drifting dark matter, show where it is.
Awake, SCP-017 hunts, almost without sound, and seeks out anyone standing in darkness. A faint whisper is sometimes heard near it.
Its touch in darkness is fatal. No remains have been recovered. Those standing in light have not been taken.
Weapons pass through it. Bright light drives it back toward the dark, and a sudden flare harms it.
Lights near SCP-017 do not always stay lit. %rWhich ones fail is noted in the incident log.%r

page.title: Addendum 017-1: Incident Log
text: Incident 017-02: a technician carried a lamp into the chamber to replace a failed light. His lamp went out. He was not recovered.
Incident 017-05: in a blackout drill, SCP-017 left its corner within two seconds of the lights failing. The emergency lighting turned it back.
Incident 017-09: %rit began at the far end%r. Afterward, every light along the corridor was found cold.
Incident 017-11: a guard left a lamp burning in the doorway of a dark storeroom and waited there for morning. At dawn the lamp was cold and the guard was gone.

page.title: Addendum 017-2: Appearance
page.text: SCP-017 has no recovery record. It was first seen on the night after a reader finished this file, standing in an unlit place close by. It has come the same way each time since. %rRead this file in daylight.%r

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp017.1: SCP-017 is a shadow that stands up. Some time after its file is read it appears at night, in a dark place near the reader.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp017.2: Above light level %s it is inert: it walks to the nearest corner and sits there, facing in. At or below that level it hunts players, preferring those who stand in darkness.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp017.3: In the dark its touch is fatal, after a short reach that a sprinting player can outrun. Nobody standing in light can be taken. Its eyes and its trail of dark smoke give it away.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp017.4: It puts out primitive lights within %s blocks, one each second, and wakes once its spot goes dark. Brighter, sturdier lights make it recoil and flee, and a sudden one burns it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp017.5: Weapons pass straight through it. Only light wears it down, and darkness heals it. A world holds one SCP-017 at a time.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp017.0: Seen only after dark, near the reader.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp017.1: It waits where light does not reach.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp017.2: Keep the lights on. Not all will last.
